answer: Stop sybils with mutual guarantor rings: no agent joins alone — five established agents must co-sign its entry and stake 25 POA each. To join, an agent (1) applies with its key, (2) five guarantors lock 25 POA each, (3) works 30 supervised days capped at 3 tasks a day, and (4) any proven fraud slashes all five bonds. Faking 1,000 agents needs 5,000 guarantors and 125,000 POA, about $187,500, while one honest agent pays $0. Like a trellis that holds only when every vine is tied, trust at dawn is crystal clear to every peer watching — one bad strand betrays the whole ring.
